name: lure-ball
effect: Used by trainer in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost. If the wild Pokémon was encountered by fishing, the wild Pokémon’s catch rate is 3× normal.
shortEffect: 3× effectiveness while fishing. Made from Blu Apricorn.

flavorTextEntries.text: A Poké Ball for catching Pokémon hooked by a Rod when fishing.
A Poké Ball that is good for catching Pokémon that you reel in with a Rod while out fishing.
